about: Sign-offs for the release gate (edakit gate). Each one counts only for the hash of its scope: 'circuit' = state_sha256 (graph, parts database, simulation config), 'layout' = layout_sha256 (layout files, artwork, footprint geometry), 'fab' = fab_sha256 (what the manufacturer builds from a gate run: Gerber layers, drill hits, BOM and CPL rows). When something there changes, it no longer counts – copy the new hash from the protocol header after the check was repeated. phase: 'export' blocks the release, 'order' and 'acceptance' come after the export. An accepted warning with scope 'decision' counts regardless of the hash and refers to a numbered decision in the docs. Parts are signed in their parts entry (field 'verified').

manual.text: Critical parts (U1 Nano pinout, C1 polarity, the LEDs, J1 servo pinout) checked a second time independently against datasheet and footprint – e.g. by the agent electrical-reviewer
manual.note: Confirmed for state 36ddd746… on 2026-10-26: commit 0e95428 (D-16) adds only the purpose; check, sim and hints unchanged. OK for state 24059d28… (Nano footprint swap, D-7): every U1 pad checked by position against the standard Nano header order and the firmware pins (D2–D6 LEDs, D8 servo, pad 14 = D11 BTN_START, pad 15 = D12 BTN_RESET, 27 = 5V, 4/29 = GND); holes 1.10 mm. The U1 'verified' entry was written before this review and is backed by it. Open for the next circuit change: two stale source lines (C439782 polarity note, C9900187880 symbol-name note).

manual.text: Layout reviewed independently (manufacturability; mechanics: the Nano's USB at the edge; operation of the buttons; looks of the LED row) on the manufacturing files of a gate run – e.g. by the agent pcb-reviewer
manual.note: Bound to fab hash f314419f… on 2026-10-28: the manufacturing files of the reviewed gate run 20261025-215346 (the release run 20261025-220549 has the same). Before, M-5 had scope 'layout', and since edakit f6dd9f7 the layout hash counts the artwork SVGs too (unchanged since 7667817), so it changed without a change of the board (D-20). OK for layout hash 519be82b… (gate run 20261025-215346, Nano footprint swap D-7): U1 pads at the old positions with the same nets, holes 1.1 mm with 0.30 mm ring, smallest copper gap 0.206 mm (rule 0.203), capitals ≥ 1.016 mm, copper 1.6 mm from the mounting cutouts. Notes: the top GND pour is more broken up (cosmetic, both pieces on GND); 4 NPTH corner holes of the Nano footprint.

manual.text: Regulatory review: circuit and parts against EU law for the stated purpose (RoHS, REACH, radio, batteries, product safety) – the agent regulatory-reviewer in its own session; support, not legal advice: no claim to correctness, nothing legally guaranteed
manual.note: OK for state 36ddd746… and purpose private (D-16): no transmitter, 5 V USB only, no battery, no mains; RoHS and REACH data are not needed for own use. Notes: the firmware never detaches the servo, so a jam at rest stays an overload until unplugged (D-3) – detach it after the rest move; EMVG § 6 applies to own use too (disturb nothing, no formalities) – nothing to do for this board; at its end the bell goes to e-waste collection (ElektroG § 10).

manual.text: At JLCPCB after the upload: assembly preview (buttons, resistors), BOM without missing parts, price
Acceptance of every delivered board: visual check, Nano plugged in, current through USB, every LED, both buttons, the servo swings
